title: Dr. Brett Cohen agrees the Great Pyramid made sulfuric acid

tellings.quote: He also agrees that the Great Pyramid was producing sulfuric acid, although completely different mechanisms of operation and stages of a reaction.

plain: The Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt was once a working chemical plant that produced sulfuric acid, according to Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who argues the pyramids were machines. He says another researcher, Brett Cohen, agrees that the pyramid made sulfuric acid, though Cohen pictures a completely different way it worked and different stages of the chemical reaction. Drumm brings this up alongside the work of an engineer named Christopher Dunn, as support for the idea that the pyramid was built to do a job and was not just a tomb.
